title: Model-based computational study of reactive fluid systems using transfer operator methods
summary: In many industrial applications one aims for the design of efficient chemical reactions. This is often done using experimental analysis of the reactors in combination with numerical twins. However, the simultaneous modeling of flow, mixing and chemical reaction remains a complicated task because the computational costs are still significant and oftentimes prohibitive. Here, we model and analyze mixing processes of chemical substances by a transfer operator method using the Lagrangian trajectories of passive particles.
